acceptance: Given the example sheet and source, the output has one row per use case, endpoint and environment with the right `change` value for matched, contradicted, new and unsourced rows, and loose or ambiguous matches never create a duplicate. (B01, B02, B03, B04)
Human-owned and forbidden columns are byte-equal to the input in every output row, and no forbidden value is ever generated. (B05)
No secret value or part of one appears in the output or the report; a literal credential is shown only as its location and `value withheld`. (B06)

`evidence_refs` holds `source:` pointers that resolve to line ranges in the real files, the output is a new CSV with the sheet's header plus a trailing `change` column, the input sheet, the tracker and the proposals are untouched, and a run limited to one use case or vendor writes only that scope. (B07, B08)

A rerun on the same inputs gives a byte-identical file, the read-back self-check result is stated in the reply, and the skill folder has no Craft term and byte-identical contract and schema copies. (B09, B10)
